description: Machine-readable adapter specs for the PT files KDPS sent. Built from the raw files; mapping to the standard fields is the analyst's reading, not a KDPS decision. No tax numbers or personal data.
header_names_trimmed: Compare header names after trimming leading and trailing spaces. Names in brackets, such as [col G, blank header], mean the column has no header text.
composite: A list as a value means several columns together (for example invoice number is prefix plus number; tax rate is CGST plus SGST).

standard_field_notes.vendor: Seller or invoicing party named in the file
standard_field_notes.buyer: Buyer, ship-to or store hint named in the file
standard_field_notes.invoice_no: Document number the file belongs to
standard_field_notes.brand: Brand as written (a code in some files)
standard_field_notes.season: Season as written (label, code or date-corrupted text)
standard_field_notes.design: Style, design or article code (KDPS column DESIGN)
standard_field_notes.category: Vendor's own product or category word
standard_field_notes.item: KDPS ITEM (approved vocabulary); only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.sub_category: KDPS SUB CATEGORY; only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.type: KDPS TYPE; only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.colour: Colour or shade (KDPS COLOR also holds price tiers)
standard_field_notes.barcode: The code to scan or print (EAN-13, internal or other)
standard_field_notes.gst_rate: GST percentage as supplied on the line
standard_field_notes.qty: Quantity on the row (can be more than 1)
standard_field_notes.cost: Unit rate before tax as billed by the vendor (KDPS column BASIC)
standard_field_notes.tax_amount: Tax amount of the line (one component or the total)
standard_field_notes.line_total: Line total as the file states it
standard_field_notes.p_rate: KDPS P RATE; only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.input_tax: KDPS INPUT TAX; only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.output_tax: KDPS OUTPUT TAX; only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.nag: KDPS NAG; only in KDPS's own layout
standard_field_notes.margin: KDPS MARGIN; only in KDPS's own layout
